limits: Historical live run reused only for identical runtime hashes; no new desktop mutations during relocation.
Eight actual MCP scenarios and two explicitly simulated controls.
No DIN, finished styling, ATS compatibility, atomic typing protection or exactly-once transport claim.
Relocation copies four runtime assets plus explicit test support; this is not release packaging.
Node, pnpm and pinned uvx schema validator are test prerequisites; no model credentials or sibling checkout used.
Privacy scan and manual shareable-asset review are separate required checks.
